answers.question: Can my mother get a pension?

lines: Your mother may be able to get a pension if she is 60 or older or if she is a widow.
She must also have no one to support her and belong to the Below Poverty Line group or have assets under Rs 1,00,000.
Please check her age and status, then visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) to apply.

answers.question: I'm a girl from a government school, now in first year of college. What can I get?

lines: You may be able to get Rs 1,000 every month under the Pudhumai Penn scheme since you studied in a government school.
You need to check if you meet the other rules like studying your first college course in Tamil Nadu.
You can apply online on the Penkalvi portal.

answers.question: I'm a boy from a government school, now in first year of college. What can I get?

lines: You may be able to get the Tamizh Pudhalvan Scheme because you are a boy from a government school now in college.
You may get Rs 1,000 every month while you study your degree.
You still need to check that your Aadhaar number is ready.

answers.question: My salary is late by 2 months. What can I do?

lines: Your employer must pay your wages before the 7th day of the next month. You have the right to get paid on time.
You can file a claim for your unpaid wages with the Inspector-cum-Facilitator or the claims authority. You have 3 years to file this claim from the day it is due.

items.title: You must get at least the minimum wage, on time

answers.question: I'm a farmer with 2 acres. What can I get?

lines: Since you are a farmer, you may be able to get Rs 6,000 a year from Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN).
You also may be able to get crop insurance through Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) to help if your crop is lost.
You may also be able to get benefits from Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam 2011 if you join as a member.

lines: உங்களுக்கு 2 ஏக்கர் நிலம் இருப்பதால் பிரதம மந்திரி கிசான் சம்மன் நிதி திட்டத்தின் மூலம் ஆண்டுக்கு Rs 6,000 பெறலாம்.

answers.question: When can I fill my own census details?

lines: You can fill in your own census details from 10 to 24 January 2027.
If you do not use this option, census staff will come house to house.
